dedupe_keys.name: urban form metrics for 462 metropolitan areas worldwide density compactness street connectivity

description: This dataset and code replicate the analysis in Urban form and its impacts on air pollution and access to green space: a global analysis of 462 cities, PLOS ONE 18(1), e0278265. Five urban form metrics, weighted density, the slope and intercept of the density gradient, compactness and street connectivity, are computed for 462 metropolitan areas worldwide, compared across regions and income, clustered into a typology with K-means and related to green space access and exposure to fine particulate matter. The paper finds that higher density brings less green space access and more PM2.5 exposure, and that street connectivity is more strongly linked to lower transport emissions. Coverage: 462 metropolitan areas. Access: data on Dryad and code on GitHub. Licence: MIT for the code; Dryad releases data under CC0. Caveats: city-level indicators only. Simulation uses are comparing cities for exposure, heat and green space access scenarios. Related records: the Toronto urban form hex measures and momepy.
name: Urban form metrics for 462 metropolitan areas worldwide (density, compactness, street connectivity)
